title_en: Constitution of the People's Republic of China (2018 Amendment)

articles.content_en: Article 1 The People's Republic of China is a socialist state under the people's democratic dictatorship led by the working class and based on the alliance of workers and peasants. The socialist system is the fundamental system of the People's Republic of China. The leadership of the Communist Party of China is the most essential characteristic of socialism with Chinese characteristics. No organization or individual may undermine the socialist system.

Article 2 All power in the People's Republic of China belongs to the people. The organs through which the people exercise state power are the National People's Congress and the local people's congresses at all levels. The people shall, in accordance with legal provisions, manage state affairs, economic and cultural undertakings, and social affairs through various channels and forms.

Article 3 The state institutions of the People's Republic of China shall apply the principle of democratic centralism. The National People's Congress and the local people's congresses at all levels shall be constituted through democratic elections, shall be responsible to the people and shall be subject to their supervision. All administrative, supervisory, adjudicatory and procuratorial organs of the state shall be created by the people's congresses, shall be responsible to them and shall be subject to their supervision. The division of functions and powers between the central and local state institutions shall follow the principle of giving full scope to the initiative and enthusiasm of local authorities under the unified leadership of the central authorities.

Article 4 All ethnic groups in the People's Republic of China are equal. The state shall protect the lawful rights and interests of all minority ethnic groups, and uphold and develop the relationship of equality, unity, mutual assistance and harmony among all ethnic groups. Discrimination against or oppression of any ethnic group shall be prohibited, and any act that undermines the unity of ethnic groups or creates ethnic divisions shall be prohibited. The state shall, in light of the characteristics and needs of the minority ethnic groups, assist the areas inhabited by minority ethnic groups in accelerating their economic and cultural development. Regional autonomy shall be practiced in areas where minority ethnic groups live in concentrated communities; autonomous organs shall be established to exercise the power of autonomy. All autonomous areas are integral parts of the People's Republic of China. All ethnic groups shall have the freedom to use and develop their own spoken and written languages, and the freedom to preserve or reform their own customs and practices.

Article 5 The People's Republic of China shall govern the country according to law and build a socialist state under the rule of law. The state shall uphold the uniformity and dignity of the socialist legal system. No laws, administrative regulations or local regulations may contravene the Constitution. All state organs and armed forces, all political parties and social organizations, and all enterprises and institutions must abide by the Constitution and laws. All acts in violation of the Constitution and laws must be investigated. No organization or individual may have the privilege of being above the Constitution and laws.

Article 6 The basis of the socialist economic system of the People's Republic of China is the socialist public ownership of the means of production, namely, ownership by the whole people and collective ownership by the working people. The socialist public ownership system shall eliminate the system of exploitation of man by man, and shall apply the principle of from each according to his ability, to each according to his work. In the primary stage of socialism, the state shall adhere to the basic economic system under which public ownership is the mainstay and diverse forms of ownership develop together, and shall adhere to the distribution system under which distribution according to work is the mainstay and multiple modes of distribution coexist.

Article 7 The state-owned economy, namely, the socialist economy under ownership by the whole people, is the leading force in the national economy. The state shall ensure the consolidation and development of the state-owned economy.

Article 8 Rural collective economic organizations shall apply the two-tier operation system that combines unified and separate operation on the basis of household contracted operation. Cooperative economic organizations in rural areas, such as those in production, supply and marketing, credit and consumption, are part of the socialist economy under collective ownership by the working people. The working people who participate in rural collective economic organizations shall have the right, within the scope provided by law, to engage in the operation of plots of cropland and hilly land allotted for private use, to engage in household sideline production, and to raise livestock allotted for private use. Cooperative economic organizations of various forms in urban areas, such as those in handicraft, industry, construction, transportation, commerce and service industries, are all part of the socialist economy under collective ownership by the working people. The state shall protect the lawful rights and interests of urban and rural collective economic organizations, and shall encourage, guide and assist the development of the collective economy.

Article 9 All mineral resources, waters, forests, mountains, grasslands, unreclaimed land, mudflats and other natural resources shall be owned by the state, i.e., owned by the whole people, with the exception of forests, mountains, grasslands, unreclaimed land and mudflats that are owned by collectives as provided by law. The state shall ensure the rational use of natural resources and protect rare animals and plants. No organization or individual may, by any means, encroach upon or destroy natural resources.

Article 10 Land in cities shall be owned by the state. Land in rural areas and suburban areas shall be owned by collectives, except for those owned by the state as provided by law; house sites and plots of cropland and hilly land allotted for private use shall also be owned by collectives. The state may, for the needs of the public interest, expropriate or requisition land and provide compensation in accordance with legal provisions. No organization or individual may encroach upon, buy, sell or otherwise illegally transfer land. The right to the use of land may be transferred in accordance with legal provisions. All organizations and individuals using land must make rational use of the land.

Article 11 Non-public sectors of the economy, such as individual and private economies, within the scope provided by law, are important components of the socialist market economy. The state shall protect the lawful rights and interests of non-public sectors of the economy, such as individual and private economies. The state shall encourage, support and guide the development of the non-public sectors of the economy, and shall conduct supervision and administration over the non-public sectors of the economy in accordance with law.

Article 12 Socialist public property is sacred and inviolable. The state shall protect socialist public property. No organization or individual may, by any means, encroach upon or destroy state-owned or collective property.

Article 13 Citizens' lawful private property is inviolable. The state shall, in accordance with legal provisions, protect citizens' rights to private property and to inheritance. The state may, for the needs of the public interest, expropriate or requisition citizens' private property and provide compensation in accordance with legal provisions.

Article 14 The state shall continuously raise labor productivity and economic efficiency, and develop social productive forces, by enhancing the enthusiasm and technical skill of working people, promoting advanced science and technology, improving the systems of economic management and enterprise operation and management, implementing various forms of socialist responsibility system and improving the organization of work. The state shall practice strict economy and combat waste. The state shall make rational arrangements for accumulation and consumption, giving due consideration to the interests of the state, collectives and individuals, and shall, on the basis of developing production, gradually improve the material and cultural life of the people. The state shall establish and improve a social security system that is compatible with the level of economic development.

Article 15 The state shall practice a socialist market economy. The state shall strengthen economic legislation and improve macroeconomic regulation and control. The state shall, in accordance with law, prohibit any organization or individual from disrupting the social economic order.

Article 16 State-owned enterprises shall have the right to operate independently within the scope provided by law. State-owned enterprises shall, in accordance with legal provisions, practice democratic management through congresses of workers and staff and other forms.

Article 17 Collective economic organizations shall have the autonomy to independently engage in economic activities, provided that they comply with relevant laws. Collective economic organizations shall practice democratic management, and shall, in accordance with legal provisions, elect and remove their management personnel and decide on major issues concerning their operation and management.

Article 18 The People's Republic of China shall permit foreign enterprises, other economic organizations or individuals to invest in China and to engage in various forms of economic cooperation with Chinese enterprises or other economic organizations in accordance with the provisions of the laws of the People's Republic of China. All foreign enterprises, other foreign economic organizations, and Chinese-foreign joint ventures within the territory of China must abide by the laws of the People's Republic of China. Their lawful rights and interests shall be protected by the laws of the People's Republic of China.

Article 19 The state shall develop socialist educational undertakings and raise the scientific and cultural level of the people throughout the country. The state shall establish various types of schools, make primary compulsory education universal, develop secondary education, vocational education and higher education, and also develop preschool education. The state shall develop various types of educational facilities, eliminate illiteracy, and provide political, cultural, scientific, technical and vocational education to workers, peasants, state functionaries and other working people. It shall encourage self-learning. The state shall encourage collective economic organizations, state enterprises and institutions, and other social forces to establish various types of educational undertakings in accordance with legal provisions. The state shall promote the use of the common national spoken and written language, Putonghua.

Article 20 The state shall develop the natural and social sciences, popularize scientific and technological knowledge, and award scientific research achievements and technological inventions and creations.

Article 21 The State shall develop medical and health services, develop modern medicine and traditional Chinese medicine, encourage and support rural collective economic organizations, State enterprises and institutions, and neighborhood organizations in establishing various medical and health facilities, and carry out mass health activities to protect the people's health. The State shall develop sports activities and carry out mass sports campaigns to improve the people's physical fitness.

Article 22 The State shall develop literature and art, news, radio and television, publishing and distribution, libraries, museums, cultural centers and other cultural undertakings that serve the people and socialism, and carry out mass cultural activities. The State shall protect places of scenic beauty and historical interest, precious cultural relics and other important historical and cultural heritage.

Article 23 The State shall train specialized personnel in all fields who serve socialism, expand the ranks of intellectuals and create conditions to give full play to their role in socialist modernization.

Article 24 The State shall strengthen the construction of socialist spiritual civilization through popularizing education in ideals, morality, culture, discipline and the legal system, and through formulating and implementing various rules and covenants among the masses in different scopes in urban and rural areas. The State shall advocate the core socialist values, promote the public virtues of love of the motherland, love of the people, love of labor, love of science and love of socialism, conduct education among the people in patriotism, collectivism, internationalism and communism, and in dialectical materialism and historical materialism, and oppose capitalist, feudal and other decadent ideas.
Article 25 The State shall promote family planning so that population growth may be commensurate with the plan for economic and social development.

Article 26 The State shall protect and improve the living environment and the ecological environment, and prevent and control pollution and other public hazards. The State shall organize and encourage afforestation and protect forests.

Article 27 All State organs shall apply the principle of streamlining, work responsibility systems, and systems for the training and assessment of functionaries, constantly improve the quality and efficiency of work, and oppose bureaucratism. All State organs and State functionaries must rely on the support of the people, maintain close contact with the people at all times, heed the opinions and suggestions of the people, accept the supervision of the people and work hard to serve the people. State functionaries shall, when taking office, publicly take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution in accordance with the provisions of law.

Article 28 The State shall maintain public order, suppress treasonable and other criminal activities that endanger State security, sanction activities that endanger public security, undermine the socialist economy and other criminal activities, and punish and reform criminals.

Article 29 The armed forces of the People's Republic of China belong to the people. Their tasks are to strengthen national defense, resist aggression, defend the motherland, protect the people's peaceful labor, participate in the country's socialist construction, and work hard to serve the people. The State shall strengthen the revolutionization, modernization and regularization of the armed forces, and enhance the national defense capability.

Article 30 The administrative division of the People's Republic of China is as follows: (1) The country is divided into provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government; (2) Provinces and autonomous regions are divided into autonomous prefectures, counties, autonomous counties and cities; (3) Counties and autonomous counties are divided into townships, ethnic townships and towns. Municipalities directly under the Central Government and other large cities are divided into districts and counties. Autonomous prefectures are divided into counties, autonomous counties and cities. All autonomous regions, autonomous prefectures and autonomous counties are autonomous areas of ethnic minorities.

Article 31 The State may establish special administrative regions when necessary. The systems to be instituted in special administrative regions shall be prescribed by law enacted by the National People's Congress in light of the specific circumstances.

Article 32 The People's Republic of China shall protect the lawful rights and interests of aliens within its territory; aliens within the territory of the People's Republic of China must abide by the laws of the People's Republic of China. The People's Republic of China may grant asylum to aliens who request it for political reasons.

Article 33 All persons holding the nationality of the People's Republic of China are citizens of the People's Republic of China. All citizens of the People's Republic of China are equal before the law. The State shall respect and protect human rights. Every citizen shall enjoy the rights prescribed by the Constitution and the law and at the same time must fulfill the obligations prescribed by the Constitution and the law.

Article 34 All citizens of the People's Republic of China who have reached the age of 18 shall have the right to vote and stand for election, regardless of ethnic status, race, sex, occupation, family background, religious belief, education, property status or length of residence, except persons deprived of political rights according to law.
Article 35 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall enjoy freedom of speech, of the press, of assembly, of association, of procession and of demonstration.

Article 36 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall enjoy freedom of religious belief. No State organ, social organization or individual may compel citizens to believe in, or not to believe in, any religion, nor may they discriminate against citizens who believe in, or do not believe in, any religion. The State shall protect normal religious activities. No person may use religion to engage in activities that disrupt public order, impair the health of citizens or interfere with the State's educational system. Religious groups and religious affairs shall not be subject to the domination of foreign forces.

Article 37 The personal freedom of citizens of the People's Republic of China shall not be violated. No citizen may be arrested except with the approval or decision of a People's Procuratorate or by decision of a People's Court, and executed by a public security organ. Unlawful detention or other methods of unlawfully depriving or restricting citizens' personal freedom shall be prohibited, and unlawful search of the person of citizens shall be prohibited.
Article 38 The personal dignity of citizens of the People's Republic of China shall not be violated. The use of any method to insult, defame or falsely accuse a citizen shall be prohibited.
Article 39 The residence of citizens of the People's Republic of China shall not be violated. Unlawful search of, or unlawful intrusion into, a citizen's residence shall be prohibited.

Article 40 The freedom and privacy of correspondence of citizens of the People's Republic of China shall be protected by law. No organization or individual may, on any ground, violate the freedom and privacy of correspondence of citizens, except in cases where, to meet the needs of State security or of investigation into criminal offenses, public security organs or procuratorial organs may examine correspondence in accordance with procedures prescribed by law.

Article 41 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the right to criticize and make suggestions to any state organ or state functionary, and have the right to make complaints, charges, or exposures to the relevant state organs regarding any illegal or derelict act of any state organ or state functionary, provided that no one may fabricate or distort facts for the purpose of false accusation or framing. The relevant state organ must ascertain the facts and handle the complaints, charges, or exposures made by citizens in a responsible manner. No person may suppress such complaints, charges, or exposures or retaliate against the complainant. Citizens who have suffered losses as a result of infringement of their rights by any state organ or state functionary shall have the right to obtain compensation in accordance with the provisions of law.

Article 42 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the right and the obligation to work. The state shall, through various channels, create conditions for employment, strengthen labor protection, improve working conditions, and, on the basis of expanded production, increase remuneration for work and welfare benefits. Work shall be the honorable duty of every able-bodied citizen. Workers in state-owned enterprises and urban and rural collective economic organizations shall approach their work as masters of the country. The state shall promote socialist labor emulation, and reward model workers and advanced workers. The state shall encourage citizens to engage in voluntary labor. The state shall provide necessary vocational training to citizens before employment.

Article 43 Working people in the People's Republic of China shall have the right to rest. The state shall develop facilities for the rest and recuperation of working people, and prescribe working hours and vacation systems for workers and staff.

Article 44 The state shall, in accordance with the provisions of law, implement a retirement system for workers and staff of enterprises and institutions and for functionaries of state organs. The livelihood of retired personnel shall be ensured by the state and society.

Article 45 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the right to material assistance from the state and society when they are old, ill, or disabled. The state shall develop the social insurance, social relief, and medical and health services needed for citizens to enjoy this right. The state and society shall ensure the livelihood of disabled soldiers, provide pensions for the families of martyrs, and give preferential treatment to the families of military personnel. The state and society shall help make arrangements for the work, livelihood, and education of blind, deaf, mute, and other disabled citizens.

Article 46 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the right and the obligation to receive education. The state shall promote the all-round development of young people, juveniles, and children in terms of morality, intellect, and physique.

Article 47 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the freedom to engage in scientific research, literary and artistic creation, and other cultural pursuits. The state shall encourage and assist creative work beneficial to the people carried out by citizens engaged in education, science, technology, literature, art, and other cultural undertakings.

Article 48 Women in the People's Republic of China shall enjoy equal rights with men in all aspects of political, economic, cultural, social, and family life. The state shall protect the rights and interests of women, apply the principle of equal pay for equal work to men and women, and train and select women cadres.

Article 49 Marriage, the family, mothers, and children shall be protected by the state. Both husband and wife shall have the obligation to practice family planning. Parents shall have the obligation to raise and educate their minor children, and adult children shall have the obligation to support and assist their parents. Infringement of the freedom of marriage shall be prohibited; maltreatment of elderly persons, women, and children shall be prohibited.

Article 50 The People's Republic of China shall protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese nationals residing abroad, and protect the lawful rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and the family members of Chinese nationals residing abroad.

Article 51 In exercising their freedoms and rights, citizens of the People's Republic of China may not infringe upon the interests of the state, society, or the collective, or upon the lawful freedoms and rights of other citizens.
Article 52 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the obligation to safeguard the unity of the country and the unity of all ethnic groups in the country.

Article 53 Citizens of the People's Republic of China must abide by the Constitution and the law, keep state secrets, protect public property, observe labor discipline, observe public order, and respect social morality.

Article 54 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the obligation to safeguard the security, honor, and interests of the motherland; they may not commit acts detrimental to the security, honor, and interests of the motherland.

Article 55 To defend the motherland and resist aggression shall be the sacred duty of every citizen of the People's Republic of China. To perform military service and join the militia in accordance with law shall be the honorable obligation of citizens of the People's Republic of China.
Article 56 Citizens of the People's Republic of China shall have the obligation to pay taxes in accordance with law.
Article 141 The national flag of the People's Republic of China shall be the red flag with five stars. The national anthem of the People's Republic of China shall be the "March of the Volunteers".
Article 142 The national emblem of the People's Republic of China shall feature Tiananmen in the center illuminated by five stars, surrounded by ears of grain and a cogwheel.
Article 143 The capital of the People's Republic of China shall be Beijing.
